title: Orrery
summary: Initialise the Orrery config (upgrade authority + settle mint), register a provider, and open a token-escrowed payment channel.
what: Orrery is an Anchor 1.2 program for a peer-to-peer AI inference network: providers list an http(s) endpoint and a price-manifest hash, and users open SPL payment channels that a session key can later redeem with an Ed25519 voucher. This lesson covers initialize, register_provider and open_channel.
app_note: The page at /dapps/orrery/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/orrery/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize, register_provider and open_channel are already done.
try_steps.see: Program 93Bs5W8q…. Fetch config J5Bu3vKR… (providers=1, channels=1, settle mint BJMSdujx…) and channel 3hvVKBsZ… (deposit=1000000, redeemed=0).

try_steps.do: initialize with min_deposit=0, or register_provider with a ftp:// endpoint, should fail.

diagram: upgrade authority --initialize--> config ["config"] + settle mint ; authority --register_provider--> provider ["provider", wallet] ; payer --open_channel--> channel ["channel", payer, provider, id] + vault ATA
accounts: channel (seeds ["channel", payer, provider, id u64 LE])
instructions: redeem / top_up / close exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: No protocol fee: channel deposits can only be redeemed to the provider against an Ed25519-signed voucher, or returned to the user when the channel closes.
exercises: Fetch the lab config, provider and channel.
Sketch how redeem verifies an Ed25519 voucher in the same transaction.
not_covered: redeem, top_up, channel close, bond and attest were not exercised. The settle mint is a lab SPL mint, not mainnet USDC.
build: Anchor 1.2.0 program at 93Bs5W8qgA2mMKmhXJWJtfYv9jKPJxJq4zZDakm8jxPu on devnet, built with --arch v2 after cargo clean. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
student_outcome: Inspect Orrery config, a provider, and a settle-token channel, then explain BadParams / BadEndpoint failures.

learning_loop.objective: Inspect config + provider + channel — then predict BadParams/BadEndpoint.
learning_loop.predict_question: open_channel is called with invalid endpoint/params for the settle mint. What should happen?

predict_options.label: Channel opens; bad params are ignored
Instruction fails with BadParams or BadEndpoint; no honest channel is created
Only the UI fails; on-chain channel still opens

learning_loop.predict_why: Orrery validates channel parameters and endpoints in the program. Illegal params fail closed rather than creating a malformed payment channel.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/orrery/ on Devnet. Fetch lab config, provider, and channel. Prefer recorded initialize/register_provider/open_channel proofs; explain BadParams and BadEndpoint from the exercises.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why must settle-mint and endpoint checks run in the program before a channel is trusted?
learning_loop.transfer: Name two rejected open_channel conditions and one channel field you would verify on-chain.
